items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: I built this place for James J. Reese's. That is, they bought almost off of me, understand? I was building this place.

ctx.x: That's... You might remember the James J. Reese's candy play people? I've heard of that thing. That's members from the Reese's candy place.

My camp is alongside of it. I built this place for James J. Reese's. That is, they bought almost off of me, understand? I was building this place. Now, them boys are from Reese's. The whole bunch in there from Reese's.
The bunch that are standing out in front of them. Yeah. With the holding a picture. And it's like they got a jug there. It says it was taken... On a Sunday... Hospital suite.
